note: Both sets share the same core claims (the -25.52E+6 watt/rad pitch sensitivity at theta=0 and theta_K = 6.302336 deg from the Figure 7-3 annotation) and the same questionable graph-read values (-30E+6, -90E+6, -120E+6) that are not stated anywhere in the text or figure labels. Set B adds four extra claims that are clearly misbound or unsupported: it reports 6.302336 deg as the rotor-collective blade-pitch angle theta and as a blade-pitch controller theta (it is theta_K, the angle at which sensitivity doubles), and it attributes the pitch sensitivity to a 'Blade-Pitch Controller' and to 'Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch' with a truncated unit 'watt/ra'. Set A avoids these misbindings and keeps the theta_K definition tied to the turbine and pitch sensitivity. Both sets also share a mislabeled 'intercept (theta_k)' and a controller-attributed version of Eq. (7-17), so neither is clean, but A is the more faithful set.
